text:
anya: nightly SBOM flagged a high-sev lib in our python base (CVE-2026-XY99). looks runtime-exploitable in theory. want emergency minimal rebase + canary sign flow.

maria: ack. keep canary internal. we need ephemeral signer keys and KMS audit shipping.

devin: i can create ephemeral KMS key with a time-bound IAM condition. will add TF snippet and ensure signer SA only gets sign rights for 4h.

ops-bot: preflight OK: builders available, registry writable.

anya: steps: 1) create ephemeral key, 2) grant SA (4h), 3) rebuild minimal base (update glibc), 4) sign & push canary to staging, 5) run fuzz+smoke, 6) revoke binding.

maria: audit-bot ensure KMS and registry logs go to s3://security-audit/2026/03/CVE-XY99/ with 1y retention.

audit-bot: confirmed. forwarding enabled.

devin: TF applied at 3350000042, key created, binding live (pushed id to ops channel). kicking CI build now.

ops-bot: build started 3350000050. console: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/11002

ops-bot: build finished 3350000058. image pushed redwood/base:canary-20260312, signed with ephemeral key version 1.

maria: running fuzz harness now. monitor for 90m. if clean, revoke binding and promote.

anya: thanks team. filing INC-2026-0312-XY99 and attaching audit paths. owner: devin (TF) + maria (audit) + ops (build).
